mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT_CONVERSATION (user_idx, anon_session_id, title, ip_address, created_at, last_active, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{anonSessionId}, #{title}, #{ipAddress}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, user_idx, anon_session_id, title, ip_address, created_at, last_active, is_deleted, sort_order FROM CHATBOT_CONVERSATION WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}

SELECT c.conversation_id, c.user_idx, c.anon_session_id, c.title, c.ip_address, c.created_at, c.last_active, c.is_deleted, c.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHATBOT_MESSAGE m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id) AS message_count FROM CHATBOT_CONVERSATION c WHERE c.user_idx = #{userIdx} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.last_active DESC

SELECT c.conversation_id, c.user_idx, c.anon_session_id, c.title, c.ip_address, c.created_at, c.last_active, c.is_deleted, c.sort_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHATBOT_MESSAGE m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id) AS message_count FROM CHATBOT_CONVERSATION c WHERE c.anon_session_id = #{anonSessionId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.last_active DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHATBOT_CONVERSATION c
LEFT JOIN USERS u ON c.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.ip_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.anon_session_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHATBOT_CONVERSATION WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
